annotations.title: Query Japan Corporate Registry, KYB & Sanctions

cleanProvenanceBadge: 100% First-Party & Open Government Licensed (commercial_resell_ok — Zero ToS-violating portal scraping)
description: Read-only, idempotent query of 5,858,407 JP firms in 47 prefectures, 44,293 domains, invoices, grades, LEIs, and OFAC (API key or x402; 24h). Pass mode with corporateNumber, domain, or lei (default mode="lookup", limit=50, offset=0); returns entities ordered by match rank. Note: For recalls, use query_regulatory_recalls instead.

amendmentsOnly.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, when true returns only amended securities/quarterly/semi-annual reports (訂正報告書) with XBRL before/after element diff metadata.

assetSymbol.description: In "ofac_sanctions" catalog browse mode (when walletAddress/entityName are omitted), optional digital currency ticker filter across 600 organization-linked SDN wallets (e.g. "TRX", "ETH", "XBT", "USDT", "ARB", "BCH", "XMR", "SOL").

companyScale.description: In "gov_qualification" mode, statutory company scale ("large" 大企業, "sme" 中小企業, "micro" 小規模企業, or "other" その他).

corporateNumber.description: 13-digit Japanese Corporate Number with valid NTA Mod-9 check digit (e.g. "6010001269339", "3120001079845") across 5,858,407 registered corporations in all 10,000 R2 shards (generation gen_37500fcdaacecf05).

corporateNumbers.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 13-digit Japanese Corporate Numbers.

docId.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, 8-character EDINET filing document ID (e.g. "S100ABCD").

domain.description: Filter or reverse-lookup by normalized official corporate website host (e.g. "andque.com", "smarthr.jp") across 107,126 D1 directory corporations / 44,227 unique corporate domains (4,551 live-measured B2A Readiness Tier & SPF/DMARC corporations).

domains.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 corporate domains for counterparty batch verification.

edinetCode.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, 6-character FSA EDINET submitter code (e.g. "E02144").

entityName.description: Organization or corporate legal name for Zero-PII OFAC SDN Entity sanctions screening.

entityNames.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 organization names for Zero-PII OFAC SDN Entity sanctions screening.

excludeGoingConcern.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, when true excludes corporations with active EDINET Going Concern notes or Going Concern material events.

excludeHighDensity50Plus.description: When true, excludes corporations registered at addresses with 50 or more co-located active corporations.

excludeLapsedLei.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, when true excludes corporations whose GLEIF LEI status is LAPSED.

excludeParrySpamObserved.description: When true, excludes entities with observed PARRY unsolicited outbound domain/telephone matches, published administrative sanction records, or revoked/expired invoice registration.

excludeRecentEdinetAmendments.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, when true excludes corporations that filed recent amended securities reports on EDINET.

goingConcernOnly.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, when true returns only corporate filings with statutory Going Concern notes (継続企業の前提に関する注記), Going Concern material events (重要事象等), or auditor Going Concern emphasis.

hasBicOnly.description: In "gleif_lei" mode, when true returns only Japanese corporations with registered SWIFT BIC codes.

includeWeakAliases.description: In "ofac_sanctions" mode, controls whether U.S. Treasury OFAC <category>weak</category> organizational AKAs (2,160 aliases) are included. Defaults to false (matches primary names + 11,549 strong AKAs only). When true, weak AKAs are also matched and tagged with matchedVia="weak_aka_alias" and akaStrength="weak".

keyword.description: Optional substring filter across corporate name, municipality, or domain.

lapsedOnly.description: In "gleif_lei" mode, when true returns only Japanese corporations whose LEI annual renewal status is LAPSED.

lei.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (e.g. "5493006W3QUS5LMH6R84" for Toyota Motor Corporation).

leis.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 20-character ISO 17442 LEI codes.

limit.description: Maximum corporate/sanctions records to return per call (1 to 1,000, default 50).

maxAddressDensity.description: Maximum number of active corporations registered at the same normalized building address (1 to 100,000, e.g. 49 or 50 to exclude high-density co-located addresses).

maxNameChangeCount.description: Maximum historical corporate name change count (0 to 1,000).

maxRelocationCount.description: Maximum historical head-office relocation count (0 to 1,000).

minQualificationGrade.description: Minimum statutory procurement qualification grade ("A" highest through "D") in "gov_qualification" or "screen" mode.

mode.description: Query mode: "lookup" / "batch" for O(1) 13-digit corporate number or domain batch lookup (1 to 1,000), "screen" / "filter" for multi-condition corporate substance & co-located address density filtering across all 47 prefectures, "gleif_lei" for ISO 17442 LEI / English corporate name / BIC / LAPSED lookup across 4,357 Japanese LEI corporations, "ofac_sanctions" for Zero-PII U.S. Treasury OFAC organizational sanctions screening (26,364 organizational records; Individual scope out_of_scope), "gov_qualification" for Digital Agency Unified Government Qualification (全省庁統一資格, Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use v2.0) A–D grade & company scale lookup across 62,630 indexed corporations in all 47 prefectures (partial catalog: 0 unresolved >500-hit slices, 13 pagination pages truncated by non-JCN rows — unindexed JCNs return not_observed), or "edinet_gc_amendments" for rolling-75d FSA EDINET API v2 Going Concern notes & amended securities report XBRL numeric diffs (3,061 filings).

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset (0..10000, default 0). Combine with limit to page through large result sets deterministically.

prefecture.description: Prefecture name or code (e.g. "東京都", "大阪府", "13").

prefectureCode.description: 2-digit JIS prefecture code ("01" to "47", e.g. "13" for Tokyo, "27" for Osaka).

qualificationGrade.description: In "gov_qualification" mode, exact statutory procurement qualification grade ("A", "B", "C", or "D").

requireGleifLei.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, when true requires the corporation to hold an active or registered GLEIF LEI.

requireInvoiceRegistered.description: When true, requires active NTA Qualified Invoice Issuer registration without revocation or expiration.

requireRealBusinessSignal.description: When true, requires at least one verified public activity signal (government procurement award, subsidy approval, IP/trademark registration, permit certification, financial disclosure, or official corporate domain).

secCode.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, 4- or 5-character Japanese securities code (e.g. "7203" or "72030").

strictExcludeUnobserved.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, controls unknown/unobserved handling for exclusion filters (excludeGoingConcern, excludeRecentEdinetAmendments, excludeLapsedLei). When false (default), unobserved corporations (e.g. not_observed_in_window for 75d EDINET or no registered LEI) are retained with explicit unobservedOrExcludedScopes[] tags (never certified clean). When true, unobserved corporations are ALSO excluded.

walletAddress.description: Crypto wallet address (EVM/Base/ETH 0x..., BTC, SOL, TRX, etc.) for OFAC SDN Digital Currency Address sanctions screening.

walletAddresses.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 crypto wallet addresses for pre-settlement OFAC sanctions screening.

name: query_corporate_registry

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this response payload was generated.

items.description: Zero-PII Japanese corporate registry (5,858,407 R2-sharded corporations, 44,293 domains, 62,630 Unified Qualification corps, 4,357 GLEIF LEIs, 3,061 EDINET GC/amendments, 14,053 Kanpo notices, 26,364 OFAC organizational records) ordered by match rank.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset applied to the matched record slice.

partialResult.description: True only if a live upstream sub-source returned partial coverage.

returnedCount.description: Number of structured records returned in items for this page.

sealStatus.description: TAPP Sigstore Rekor cryptographic Merkle seal status of the dataset.

sha256Digest.description: Deterministic 64-character hex SHA-256 provenance digest of the returned items.

stats.description: Execution telemetry including itemCount, durationMs, and upstream breakdown.

streamId.description: Underlying B2A data stream identifier that fulfilled the query.

success.description: True when the read-only query completed without upstream or validation failure.

toolName.description: Executed MCP tool name for deterministic audit correlation.
